# unraid_vars (Data Source)

Selected system variables (`var.ini`) of the Unraid server. Requires `READ_ANY` on `VARS`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_vars" "this" {}

output "unraid_version" {
  value = data.unraid_vars.this.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Server description.
- `default_fs_type` (String) Default file system for new disks.
- `domain` (String) Domain name.
- `fs_state` (String) File system state.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the vars object.
- `local_tld` (String) Local top-level domain.
- `md_state` (String) Array (md) state.
- `name` (String) Server hostname.
- `ntp_servers` (List of String) Configured NTP servers 1-4 (empty strings for unused slots).
- `port` (Number) Web UI HTTP port.
- `port_ssh` (Number) SSH port.
- `port_ssl` (Number) Web UI HTTPS port.
- `registration_type` (String) License type.
- `share_cache_enabled` (Boolean) Whether cache is enabled for shares.
- `share_count` (Number) Number of user shares.
- `share_mover_schedule` (String) Mover schedule (cron expression).
- `share_nfs_enabled` (Boolean) Whether NFS is enabled.
- `share_smb_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SMB is enabled.
- `spindown_delay` (String) Default disk spin-down delay.
- `start_array` (Boolean) Whether the array starts automatically on boot.
- `time_zone` (String) Configured time zone.
- `use_ntp` (Boolean) Whether NTP time sync is enabled.
- `use_ssh` (Boolean) Whether SSH is enabled.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Whether the web UI uses SSL.
- `use_telnet` (Boolean) Whether telnet is enabled.
- `version` (String) Unraid OS version.
- `workgroup` (String) SMB workgroup.
